text:
Sam W: Quick check — Friday watch party at 7pm in the kitchen? I can grab chips but my fantasy team needs help. AJ Brown or Derrick Henry for flex? 🤔
Maya P: I’ll bring guac. chips are on me if someone volunteers dip containers :avocado:
Raj S: Flex pick: Henry if you need guaranteed volume, AJ if you need ceiling. Who are you up against?
Sam W: Playing @Elena C — she’s been crushing it. leaning AJ for the boom but worried about target share.
Elena C: LOL @Sam W I bench-locked you mentally. also I’ll bring paper plates.
Devon: I’m team Henry. plus I can bring that spicy kettle chips everyone fights over. warning: addictive.
Olivia: Poll — chips style? React with emoji to vote: 1️⃣ for Tortilla chips, 2️⃣ for Kettle, 3️⃣ for Multigrain. Also do we want a tiny bracket pool for the game?
Ben T: I vote 2️⃣. Also yes on a tiny bracket. $2 buy-in, winner gets the last slice of pizza next week.
Sam W: Love the stakes. ok Henry if conservative, AJ if gamble. I’ll post my lineup here in 5 and we can quick veto.
Maya P: Re: lineup — can someone confirm if Julio is active?
Raj S: Julio is listed as questionable but practicing. I’d slot AJ in and have a backup.
Sam W: ```
Lineup:
QB: T.Bradley
RB1: Derrick Henry
RB2: Chark
WR1: AJ Brown
WR2: K.Allen
Flex: AJ Brown / D. Henry (TBD)
K: M.Crosby
DEF: Seahawks
```
Olivia: @Sam W I'd go AJ flex unless opponent stacks your matchup, then Henry. also I’ve added a Google sheet for chip signup: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-chips (use initials to sign up)
Elena C: I signed up for dip containers. Snackbot, can you confirm we have plates and napkins on Friday?
Snackbot: Confirmed — inventory shows 30 plates, 50 napkins. Ordering 20 extra forks because last time we ran out. :robot_face:
Devon: Also bringing a tiny speaker. whoever wants playlist add songs to the 'Friday Bops' doc.
Ben T: Reminder — react to Olivia's poll for chips. I put 2️⃣ already.
Sam W: Thanks team. Final decision: Henry in starting lineup, AJ in flex if we need upside tomorrow morning. See you Friday. :football:
